title: Tumble and Nana's Wiggle-Waggle Dance
moral: When we listen to our elders and help them, we learn wonderful things.
description: Tonight is the Harvest Hop, and Pip and Tumble need a dance! Wise Nana Hoot knows the silly Wiggle-Waggle dance, but can Tumble find his knees and reach his toes? Pat your head, touch your nose and learn the parts of the body in this funny animated story about listening to and helping our elders, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Tonight is the Harvest Hop, the biggest dance party in all of Clover Wood!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! Tumble, we need the best dance EVER!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I know a dance! Watch me spin! Spinny, spinny, spinny...
Round and round went Tumble... wibble-wobble... and... BONK! He bumped right into a big orange pumpkin!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee hee! Maybe we need a dance teacher. Let's ask Nana Hoot!
Nana Hoot was resting on her porch, sipping a cup of warm tea.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana Hoot! Can you teach us a dance? A fast one! A zoomy one! Right NOW!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! When I was a young owl, I danced the Wiggle-Waggle dance! But first, open your ears and listen carefully.
Nana's round glasses slid down, down, DOWN her beak. Wheeee!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ears open, Nana! And I'm zipping my mouth shut. Zzzip!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: The Wiggle-Waggle dance goes like this. First... pat your HEAD! Pat, pat, pat!
Can YOU pat your head? Ready? Pat, pat, pat!
Great job! Next, touch your NOSE. Your nose is for smelling flowers!
Tumble touched his long nose... it tickled... AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO!
WHOOSH! Nana's feathers went all fluffy-puffy! Hoo-hoo-HOO, she laughed.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Now, wiggle your KNEES, my dears! Wiggle, wiggle!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Knees? Oh, I know! My knees are... on top of my head!
Hee hee! No, silly Tumble! Your knees are in the middle of your legs. Bendy-bendy knees!
Then, touch your TOES! How many toes do YOU have? Wiggle them and count!
Ten! Ten wiggly toes! Tumble reached for his toes... but his round tummy got in the way. Wobble, wobble... BOING! Right on his bottom!
Down by the lily pond, Tumble tried one more time. He lifted his foot up high... Hello, toes! Hooray!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Lovely! Now, clap your two hands and... and... zzzzz...
Hee hee! Nana fell fast asleep, right in the middle of the dance!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Clap, clap, CLAP your hands!
Pip clapped so fast and twirled so quick, he got all tangled up in the party ribbons! Wibble-wobble-whoops!
At sunset, it was time for the Harvest Hop! But the path up the hill was long and steep.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Come on, come on! Let's run! Zoom, zoom!
Pip zoomed ahead... then he stopped and looked back. Nana's wings were tired, and her steps were slow.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana, we'll walk at YOUR speed. Slow and steady, all together.
Tumble gave Nana his trunk to hold, and Pip carried her comfy cushion. Step... step... step!
The party lanterns glowed pink and gold. Everyone wanted to see the Wiggle-Waggle dance!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana, you dance first! You're the best teacher in Clover Wood!
So they danced all together! Pat your head! Touch your nose! Wiggle your knees! Touch your toes!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: And blink your two eyes! Blink, blink! Hoo-hoo-HOO!
Tumble was so happy, his trunk went HONK! And everybody cheered!
Let's remember, friends! What do we use to smell yummy flowers?
Our NOSE! Sniff, sniff! You're so smart!
And how many toes do we have? Wiggle them and count!
Ten! Ten wiggly toes! Hooray, you're body-part super stars!
That night, Pip and Tumble walked Nana all the way home. Slow and steady.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Thank you, my dears. You listened so well, and you were so kind to an old owl.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Thank YOU, Nana! Tomorrow, can you teach us another dance? A slow one!
But Nana was already snoozing. Zzzz... Tumble giggled so hard, his trunk went... HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO!
